qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the holder to transfer case (16AZ) on the 265 Sport transmission?
What is the torque value for the retaining plates for bearings on housing?
Which transmission types use the retaining plates for bearings on housing (17AZ)?
qa_pairs.answer: S 5 D 310 Z/S 5 D 200 G/250 G transmissions.

qa_pairs.question: What section of the manual covers the Case and Cover specifications?
What is the difference in torque specifications between the holder to transfer case and the retaining plates for bearings?
qa_pairs.answer: The retaining plates for bearings require 10 Nm while the holder to transfer case requires 9 Nm, a difference of 1 Nm.

qa_pairs.question: Do both components listed use the same screw size?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, both the holder to transfer case and retaining plates for bearings on housing use M6 screws.

qa_pairs.question: What type of transmission is the 265 Sport?
qa_pairs.answer: 265 Sport (as listed in the Type column for component 16AZ).
